rules.hybrid_card_policy: Enhance one primary effect only: Attack damage, Defend Block, Skill its explicitly listed effect.
rules.damage_timing: Compute ordinary upgraded/stat-modified attack, then add flat Focus bonus once, then apply ordinary mitigation.
rules.block_timing: Compute ordinary upgraded/stat-modified Block, then add flat Focus bonus once.
rules.no_effect_policy: If preview proves the Focus-specific bonus cannot produce any benefit (such as no capacity beyond base draw), show ordinary effect and preserve the Focus stock and armed state. A legal random/search attempt may still fail after commit; that is not refunded.

design_defaults.new_combat: restore deck and exhaust; clear temporary attributes, passives, counters, queues, Focus stock and armed/used flags
turn_start_order: snapshot existing Block; apply highest carry cap
reset Energy to design default and Focus-used flag
draw normal amount plus queued/Passive bonuses
design_defaults.normal_draw: if Draw Pile empty, seeded-shuffle eligible Discard Pile; never include currently resolving/exhausted/active Passive cards; stop if both piles empty
design_defaults.choice_windows: before starting, refill only if Draw Pile empty; no reshuffle during bounded look/search/replace sequence; resolve available cards only
design_defaults.no_target: Attack cards and selected-enemy effects require a living target before commit; combat-end aborts remaining damage/queues
on_play_order: snapshot context including empty hand after removing card
pay Energy and eligible Focus once atomically
move played instance to discard/exhaust/active Passive zone
design_defaults.damage_order: base + Strength + conditional bonus + Focus(first event only) + Vulnerable(+2) - Weak(2), clamp >=0; then Defense, clamp >=0; then Block unless bypassed; then HP
design_defaults.trigger_rules: triggered damage and Block do not count as played cards; fixed Passive damage bypasses mitigation and cannot trigger Attack/on-hit/Thorns loops

passive.on_focus: retain normal frame; no Focus variant or glow overlays

layout.notes: All rectangles are in the common padded native canvas. Multiply all coordinates by 2 for 4K. Original raster files remain byte-identical.
